shots.visual_event: Nila crosses the cyan memory bridge. The red exchange plaque turns blank and fractures into harmless brass dust.
Around the city, missing people return to families who remember them; volunteers notice one small chosen memory is gone, exactly as agreed.
shots.dialogue_audio: Rohan: “I lost one morning. I got my sister.”

shots.visual_event: Elias steps off the train beside Maya as an ordinary aging man; she gives him the cracked mask, then closes his fingers around the handbell instead.
Meera installs a simple wind-up spring in Tick. His cyan eyes relight; he stands on four paws and wags his segmented tail without supernatural clock power.
Arin cannot recover the surrendered childhood image of Meera, so she recreates it by resting her head on his shoulder during a new monsoon blackout.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “We make another memory.” Arin: “And keep this one together.”

shots.visual_event: At dawn, Arin, Meera, and Tick walk away from the now-public Platform 13. A distant unused arch briefly reveals a different KAAPAV ARC world, but they do not enter.
shots.dialogue_audio: Narrator: “The midnight train never returned—because nobody was waiting to be replaced.”

end_card.text: THE MIDNIGHT PLATFORM — SEASON ONE COMPLETE
